title: Front cockpit
source: JoyPro's labels, placed on the photo by looking at it (2026-10-31)

labels.text: Sight head and its control box

labels.note: Switches that let the aircraft hold its height and course by itself and smooth out wobbles.
Small lamps that light up to tell the pilot when something needs attention.
Shows the pilot whether the nose points up or down and how much the wings are tilted.
A compass dial that shows which way the aircraft points and where the next waypoint is.
Number keys the pilot uses to type data into the aircraft's computers.
